extDescription.message: Syncs your browser bookmarks with your Nextcloud.

optionsSyncModeRestHint.message: Uses the NEXTBookmarks app installed on the server. Needed if you want fine-grained sync and an overview page inside Nextcloud.

optionsSyncModeWebdavHint.message: Stores all bookmarks as a single file in the "NEXTBookmarks" folder in your Nextcloud files. Works on any Nextcloud, even without installed apps (e.g. on restricted hosting plans) - no overview page inside Nextcloud.

errorWebdavConflict.message: Another device just changed the bookmarks file at the same time. Please sync again shortly.

optionsAutoSyncOnChange.message: On local changes in the browser

optionsAutoSyncHint.message: The very first sync to a new connection always has to be started manually ("Sync now" button). After that it runs automatically according to the rule chosen here.

optionsSkipFolderNameHint.message: Optional: a top-level folder with this name is skipped when syncing - its contents end up directly in the root folder instead. Handy for Vivaldi's "Speed Dial" folder, so its groups don't end up in an extra intermediate folder. The list only shows this browser's top-level folders, so nothing unrelated can be picked by mistake.

optionsImportDescription.message: Did you skip the import on first run? You can catch up on it here.

optionsBackupDescription.message: Saves all current bookmarks as a file on your computer - independent of sync, importable into any browser.

optionsBackupDoneCloudStatus.message: Saved and also uploaded to the cloud (NEXTBookmarks/backups/).

optionsBackupDoneLocalOnlyStatus.message: Saved locally. Cloud upload not possible (no/wrong credentials or connection error).

optionsBackupImportDoneStatus.message: $count$ bookmarks imported into a new folder.

optionsDeleteAllBookmarksDescription.message: Handy right after a fresh browser install: removes all default bookmarks before your first sync, so they don't end up permanently in your cloud by accident.

optionsDeleteAllBookmarksConfirm.message: Really delete ALL bookmarks in this browser irreversibly? This cannot be undone - use "Export backup" first if needed.

optionsResetCloudDescription.message: If the cloud data has gotten messy (e.g. nested/duplicate folders from earlier sync bugs): deletes ALL bookmarks on the server (for the currently selected connection type) and then re-uploads this browser's bookmarks completely fresh - this browser becomes the sole source of truth.

optionsResetCloudButton.message: Delete cloud data and re-upload from this browser

optionsResetCloudConfirm.message: Really delete ALL bookmarks on the server irreversibly and replace them with this browser's bookmarks? Other devices will lose their previous sync state. This cannot be undone.

onboardingImportFromCloudQuestion.message: Should your existing bookmarks from Nextcloud be imported into this browser?

onboardingUploadToCloudQuestion.message: Should your local bookmarks from this browser be uploaded to Nextcloud?

onboardingImportDoneStatus.message: Done! $created$ bookmarks transferred. You can close this window now.

onboardingSkippedStatus.message: Skipped – your existing bookmarks remain untouched. You can close this window now.

errorMissingCredentials.message: Please enter your Nextcloud credentials in the settings first.

errorInvalidServerUrl.message: The Nextcloud URL is invalid. Please start with https://, e.g. https://cloud.example.com.

errorPermissionDenied.message: Can't sync without permission to access this Nextcloud domain. Please click Save again and allow the permission.

errorHostPermissionMissing.message: No access permission has been granted for this server on this device yet (permissions aren't synced automatically between devices). Please open the settings and click Save once.

errorMassDeleteGuard.message: Safety abort: $count$ out of $known$ known bookmarks would be deleted - that's unusually many, so nothing was deleted. Please check that the correct server/account is configured before syncing again.
